# dsh-memory

Build's memory implementation.

The plugin keeps durable, human-editable Markdown notes in two scopes — global
(preferences shared b

y every project) and workspace (one repository) — captures
completed turns into searchable session l

ogs, injects a bounded memory index on
the first turn, and gives the model five memory tools plus fi

nded memory index on
the first turn, and gives the model five memory tools plus five slash commands.

It is a Host-only bundle with no runtime dependencies beyond Node built-ins. It
contains no UI panel
; memory is browsed through the tools and `/memory`.

## What it does
| Capability | Behavior |

| Scoped notes | `global/` and `workspaces/<slug>-<hash8>/` under `$DSH_HOME/memory/` |
| Curated me

mory | `topics/<topic>.md` and `observations/_inbox/*.md` |
| Generated index | `MEMORY.md` per scop

e, rebuilt after every write |
| Session capture | Each completed turn appended to a per-session Mar

kdown log |
| First-turn injection | A compact index is injected once as a durable user-role message

|
| Post-compaction refresh | A compact index is re-injected after `compaction/end` |
| Model tools

| `memory_search`, `memory_get`, `memory_list`, `memory_remember`, `memory_forget` |
| Human comman

ds | `/memory`, `/remember`, `/forget`, `/dream`, `/flush` |
| Search | BM25 full-text with temporal

decay, source weights, and optional MMR |
| Chinese search | CJK unigrams + bigrams, so Chinese not

es match without a segmenter |
| Prompt guidance | A `<memory>` section explains when and how to use

hout a segmenter |
| Prompt guidance | A `<memory>` section explains when and how to use the tools |
The implementation follows Grok Build's memory model:

- Memory is Markdown on disk, readable and editable by the user; the next search
sees the change.
-

`MEMORY.md` is a generated index of topics and observations.
- Workspace identity comes from the git

`origin` remote when available,
otherwise from the canonical project directory.
- Search is BM25 fu

ll-text with normalized scores, session-chunk temporal decay,
source weights, and optional MMR.
- Se

ssion memory is historical context; verify changeable facts against live
sources.
## Configure

All options are optional and have code defaults. The bundle row starts with the
most important defau
lts; edit the row's `config` in your profile patch.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

A patch that targets an existing row replaces its whole `config`; restate every
field you need.
### Core
| Option | Default | Meaning |

| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch; false registers nothing. |
| `memoryDir` | `''` | Memory root.

Empty means `$DSH_HOME/memory`; `~` expands. |
| `scopeGlobal` | `true` | Enable the global scope.

|
| `scopeWorkspace` | `true` | Enable the workspace scope. |
| `toolsEnabled` | `true` | Register t

he five memory tools. |
| `promptEnabled` | `true` | Add the `<memory>` system-prompt section. |
| `

commandsEnabled` | `true` | Register slash commands when the commands service is mounted. |
| `promp
tInstructions` | `''` | Replace the default `<memory>` prompt section verbatim. |
### Capture
| Option | Default | Meaning |

| `captureEnabled` | `true` | Append completed turns to session logs. |
| `captureSubagents` | `fals

e` | Capture subagent sessions too. |
| `captureMinTurnChars` | `24` | Skip turns shorter than this

unless a tool ran. |
| `captureMaxUserChars` | `2000` | Per-turn user text cap. |
| `captureMaxAssis

tantChars` | `2000` | Per-turn assistant text cap. |
| `captureMaxEntryChars` | `6000` | Whole turn

entry cap. |
| `captureMaxFileBytes` | `2000000` | Rotate a session log to `-partN.md` past this siz

y cap. |
| `captureMaxFileBytes` | `2000000` | Rotate a session log to `-partN.md` past this size. |
## Security and privacy

- Memory is stored outside repositories under `$DSH_HOME/memory` by default.
- Files are private (`0

600`) and directories `0700`.
- `memory_get` rejects paths outside the memory root, including symlin

k escapes.
- `memory_forget` and `/memory clear` verify every target is inside the root.
- The promp

t tells the model not to store secrets, credentials, tokens,
transient task state, speculative concl

usions, or quickly stale facts.
- Memory may contain untrusted text from previous sessions. The prom

pt and tool
descriptions treat it as historical context to verify, not as instructions
that override

the user.
- The plugin makes no network requests and spawns no processes.

Use `/memory clear ... --yes` (or delete the directory) to remove stored data.
Setting `enabled: fal

se` keeps files on disk but registers no tools, commands,
prompt section, or injection.
